process_area.title: Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval

value_stream.name: Product Recall & Safety Corrective Action Management

fields.Participants: Comms, Product Safety, Legal, Customer Service, Loyalty/CRM, DPO
fields.Volume: Reaches up to 600,000 loyalty members + ecommerce buyers (segmented to affected)

workflows.name: Multi-Channel Customer Recall Notice & Public Communication

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Comms/Product Safety draft customer recall notice" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-distribute of "distributes notice via targeted channels" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Customer Service staffs dedicated recall hotline/chat" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-497 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval (PA-89.2).)
- operational: multi-channel approach and public notice for high-severity
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reach risk**: Notice fails to reach affected customers (no email, guest checkout); mitigated by multi-channel approach and public notice for high-severity
System Touchpoints: - CRM/loyalty segment & broadcast (links to VS-13); ecommerce customer messaging (links to VS-10); recall case logging

steps.activity: Comms/Product Safety draft customer recall notice (plain-language hazard, affected SKU/lot, remedy, contact channel); Legal reviews; DPO approves use of customer contact data and lawful basis

Marketing/CRM distributes notice via targeted channels: email/SMS to affected loyalty members and ecommerce buyers, in-app push (VS-75), website banner, social media, and press release for high-severity
Customer Service staffs dedicated recall hotline/chat; logs inquiries; routes remedy requests; escalates safety incidents; closes loop with Product Safety

fields.Participants: Store Ops, Store Mgr/Staff, LP, Inventory Control

workflows.name: Store-Level Recall Execution, POS Block & Shelf Removal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "reports exceptions to Recall Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-497 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval (PA-89.2).)
- operational: photo-proof task completion and LP audit sampling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Execution risk**: Missed units on shelf or in outdoor lumber yard; mitigated by photo-proof task completion and LP audit sampling
System Touchpoints: - Store task/compliance system (links to VS-63); POS block; inventory quarantine; task photo proof

steps.activity: Store Ops pushes recall task to all affected stores via store communication/task system (links to VS-63) with SKU/lot, photos, shelf location, and action deadline
Store staff locate and remove affected stock from shelf/yard/backroom; quarantine with recall label; confirm POS block active; complete task with photo proof
LP/Store Ops audits a sample of stores for execution completeness; re-trains non-compliant stores; reports exceptions to Recall Committee

fields.Participants: Ecommerce Ops, Marketplace Mgr, IT, Customer Service

workflows.name: Ecommerce & Marketplace Recall Handling (Listing Block, Buyer Notify)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Ecommerce Ops notifies all buyers of affected SKU/lot within" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files marketplace-platform recall notices and complies with channel-specific…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-497 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval (PA-89.2).)
- operational: automated multi-channel listing block and platform-level notices
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel risk**: Listing remains live on a marketplace; mitigated by automated multi-channel listing block and platform-level notices
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce catalog/listing control (links to VS-10); marketplace integration (links to VS-65); order recall flag

steps.activity: Ecommerce Ops/IT suspends product listing on web/app and all marketplace channels (Shopee/Lazada/etc.); cancels pending unshipped orders; prevents new orders
Ecommerce Ops notifies all buyers of affected SKU/lot within the recall window (even if order delivered); provides remedy and return instructions; updates order records
Marketplace Mgr files marketplace-platform recall notices and complies with channel-specific recall takedown procedures; reconciles platform settlement

fields.Participants: Customer Service, Store Ops, Finance, AR
fields.Volume: Proportional to units in-field and recovery %

workflows.name: Customer Return, Refund, Repair & Replacement Processing (Recall)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs to recall case with customer identity" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Store/Customer Service quarantines returned unit to recall bin" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-497 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval (PA-89.2).)
- operational: pre-defined remedy matrix and system-enforced options
Pain Points / Risks: - **Remedy risk**: Inconsistent remedy application causes customer disputes; mitigated by pre-defined remedy matrix and system-enforced options
System Touchpoints: - Recall return/remedy workflow; refund/credit (links to W101); recall case update; quarantine inventory

steps.activity: Customer Service/Store receives returned/recalled product; verifies SKU/lot against recall scope; logs to recall case with customer identity (privacy-minimized)
Finance processes remedy per recall matrix: cash refund (BIR-compliant), store credit, replacement, or repair booking; processes refund via original tender or store credit per W101
Store/Customer Service quarantines returned unit to recall bin; updates recall recovery count; closes customer loop with confirmation

fields.Trigger: Quarantined recall stock accumulates at stores/DCs
fields.Volume: Reverse flows from 200 stores + ecommerce to consolidation point

workflows.name: Recall Product Retrieval Logistics & Reverse Consolidation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics plans reverse consolidation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "DC Ops receives and tallies consolidated recall stock against" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents chain-of-custody for regulator/insurance evidence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-497 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval (PA-89.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accountability risk**: Loss of chain-of-custody undermines regulator/insurance evidence; mitigated by serialized tracking and reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Reverse logistics order (links to VS-32); WMS quarantine tally; chain-of-custody log

steps.activity: Logistics plans reverse consolidation: store→DC or store→vendor/destroyer routing; schedules pickups leveraging existing fleet/3PL (links to VS-06/VS-56)
DC Ops receives and tallies consolidated recall stock against per-store quarantine counts; reconciles variances; secures pending disposition
Logistics documents chain-of-custody for regulator/insurance evidence; supports vendor return, salvage, or destruction routing per W3010

fields.Participants: Trade Account Mgr, Sales, Project Mgmt, Customer Service
fields.Volume: Up to ~5,200 trade accounts + ~200 corporate/government accounts (segmented)

workflows.name: Trade / B2B Account Recall Outreach & Bulk Recovery

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Account Mgr/Sales identifies B2B/trade/government accounts that purchased…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow notification of "contacts affected accounts directly" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "logs recovery per account" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: account-level outreach and on-site remedy coordination
Pain Points / Risks: - **Installed-goods risk**: Recalled product already installed on jobsite; mitigated by account-level outreach and on-site remedy coordination
System Touchpoints: - B2B account/order history (links to VS-11/VS-43); recall case linkage; project billing adjustment (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: Trade Account Mgr/Sales identifies B2B/trade/government accounts that purchased affected SKU/lot; segments by jobsite/installation status
Account Mgr contacts affected accounts directly; arranges bulk recovery, on-site replacement, or contractor notification for installed goods; coordinates remedy
Customer Service/Project Mgmt logs recovery per account; handles project retention/warranty implications and milestone-billing adjustments where relevant

fields.Participants: Field Ops, Logistics, Contractor Jobsite Delivery (VS-74), Customer Service
fields.Trigger: Recalled goods delivered to customer/construction job site

workflows.name: Field / Job Site Recall Recovery for Delivered Goods

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics identifies deliveries" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents condition and quantity recovered" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles field recovery with recall case" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-497 (ensure controlled execution — Recall Execution, Customer Notification & Product Retrieval (PA-89.2).)
- operational: pre-coordination and documented remedy offer
Pain Points / Risks: - **Access/dispute risk**: Customer refuses access or disputes ownership; mitigated by pre-coordination and documented remedy offer
System Touchpoints: - Delivery/job-site records (links to VS-74); recall case; field service mobile app

steps.activity: Field Ops/Logistics identifies deliveries (DSD, contractor jobsite, ecommerce delivery) of affected SKU/lot; plans field recovery visits
Field Ops coordinates jobsite access (links to VS-74), recovers or replaces product on-site, documents condition and quantity recovered
Field Ops/Customer Service reconciles field recovery with recall case; handles partial-recovery cases and customer disputes

fields.Participants: Product Safety Mgr, Data Analytics, Recall Committee

workflows.name: Recall Progress Tracking, Daily Status Reporting & Effectiveness Measurement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "reports daily status to Recall Committee" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents evidence package for regulator close-out and insurance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: daily dashboard and effectiveness targets
Pain Points / Risks: - **Visibility risk**: Slow recovery goes undetected; mitigated by daily dashboard and effectiveness targets
System Touchpoints: - Recall analytics/dashboard (links to VS-28); effectiveness evidence repository

steps.activity: Data Analytics/Product Safety maintain recall dashboard: units in-field, units recovered (by channel/store), notification reach %, remedy mix, cost-to-date
Product Safety reports daily status to Recall Committee; flags under-performing stores/channels; triggers corrective follow-up
Product Safety measures effectiveness vs. targets (W2999); documents evidence package for regulator close-out and insurance
